```{r}
df <- read.csv("~/Desktop/abcd_coi.csv")
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    across(ends_with("_Ten1_FA"), scale),
    across(starts_with("nih"), scale),
    across(starts_with("coi"), scale)
  )
```


```{r}
#COI Overall -> SLF-I left -> Cognition --- Mediation model

fit_and_evaluate_gam <- function(data, response, predictors, smooth_terms, k_values) {
  results <- list()  
  
  for (k in k_values) {
    smooth_formula <- paste(
      sapply(smooth_terms, function(term) paste0("s(", term, ", k = ", k, ")")),
      collapse = " + "
    )
    

    full_formula <- paste(response, "~", smooth_formula, "+", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))
    
    # Fit the GAM model
    gam_model <- gam(as.formula(full_formula), data = data)
    
    results[[paste("k =", k)]] <- list(model = gam_model, AIC = AIC(gam_model))
  }
  

  best_k <- as.numeric(gsub("k = ", "", names(which.min(sapply(results, function(x) x$AIC)))))
  best_model <- results[[paste("k =", best_k)]]$model
  
  return(list(best_model = best_model, best_k = best_k, all_results = results))
}

k_values <- seq(3, 11, by = 1)


mediator_smooth_terms <- c("coi_total_raw", "interview_age", "parenteducation", "bmi", "rel_family_id", "dmri_meanmotion")
mediator_linear_predictors <- c(
  "factor(sex)", "factor(race)", "factor(ethnicity)", "factor(totalincome)",
  "factor(puberty_stage)", "factor(sleep_category)", "factor(fam_hx)"
)

outcome_smooth_terms <- c("SLF_I_left_Ten1_FA", "coi_total_raw", "interview_age", "parenteducation", "bmi", "rel_family_id", "dmri_meanmotion")
outcome_linear_predictors <- c(
  "factor(sex)", "factor(race)", "factor(ethnicity)", "factor(totalincome)",
  "factor(puberty_stage)", "factor(sleep_category)", "factor(fam_hx)", "factor(site_id_l)"
)

total_effect_smooth_terms <- c("coi_total_raw", "interview_age", "parenteducation", "bmi", "rel_family_id")
total_effect_linear_predictors <- c(
  "factor(sex)", "factor(race)", "factor(ethnicity)", "factor(totalincome)",
  "factor(puberty_stage)", "factor(sleep_category)", "factor(fam_hx)", "factor(site_id_l)"
)

# Initialize lists to store results
all_results <- list()
all_bootstrap_results <- list()

# Get all cognition outcome columns starting with "nihtbx_"
cognition_outcomes <- grep("^nihtbx_", names(df), value = TRUE)

# Process each cognition outcome
for (cognition_col in cognition_outcomes) {
  cat("Processing:", cognition_col, "\n")
  
  # Step 1: Mediator Model (FA ~ COI + Covariates + dmri_meanmotion)
  mediator_results <- fit_and_evaluate_gam(
    data = df,
    response = "SLF_I_left_Ten1_FA",
    predictors = mediator_linear_predictors,
    smooth_terms = mediator_smooth_terms,
    k_values = k_values
  )
  best_mediator_model <- mediator_results$best_model
  best_k_mediator <- mediator_results$best_k
  
  # Print summary for the mediator model
  cat("\n--- Summary for Mediator Model (FA ~ COI) ---\n")
  print(summary(best_mediator_model))
  cat("Best k for Mediator Model:", best_k_mediator, "\n")
  
  # Step 2: Outcome Model (Cognition ~ FA + COI + Covariates)
  outcome_results <- fit_and_evaluate_gam(
    data = df,
    response = cognition_col,
    predictors = outcome_linear_predictors,
    smooth_terms = outcome_smooth_terms,
    k_values = k_values
  )
  best_outcome_model <- outcome_results$best_model
  best_k_outcome <- outcome_results$best_k
  
  # Print summary for the outcome model
  cat("\n--- Summary for Outcome Model (Cognition ~ FA + COI) ---\n")
  print(summary(best_outcome_model))
  cat("Best k for Outcome Model:", best_k_outcome, "\n")
  
  # Step 3: Total Effect Model (Cognition ~ COI + Covariates)
  total_effect_results <- fit_and_evaluate_gam(
    data = df,
    response = cognition_col,
    predictors = total_effect_linear_predictors,
    smooth_terms = total_effect_smooth_terms,
    k_values = k_values
  )
  best_total_effect_model <- total_effect_results$best_model
  best_k_total_effect <- total_effect_results$best_k
  
  # Print summary for the total effect model
  cat("\n--- Summary for Total Effect Model (Cognition ~ COI + Covariates) ---\n")
  print(summary(best_total_effect_model))
  cat("Best k for Total Effect Model:", best_k_total_effect, "\n")
  
  # Step 4: Predict Mediator (FA) and Outcome (Cognition)
  df$M_pred <- predict(best_mediator_model, newdata = df)  # Predicted FA
  df$Y_pred <- predict(best_outcome_model, newdata = df)   # Predicted Cognition
  
  # Step 5: Compute Indirect Effect using Linear Regression
  indirect_effect <- lm(Y_pred ~ M_pred, data = df)
  indirect_effect_coefficient <- coef(indirect_effect)[2]
  
  # Step 6: Compute Mediation Proportion
  total_effect <- summary(best_total_effect_model)$s.table["s(coi_total_raw)", "F"]
  mediation_proportion <- indirect_effect_coefficient / total_effect
  
  # Step 7: Bootstrapping for Confidence Intervals
  set.seed(123)
  bootstrap_results <- replicate(1000, {
    sample_indices <- sample(nrow(df), replace = TRUE)
    df_sample <- df[sample_indices, ]
    
    mediator_model <- gam(
      SLF_I_left_Ten1_FA ~ s(coi_total_raw, k = best_k_mediator) + 
        s(interview_age, k = best_k_mediator) + s(dmri_meanmotion, k = best_k_mediator) +
        factor(sex) + factor(race) + factor(ethnicity) + factor(totalincome) +
        s(parenteducation, k = best_k_mediator) + s(bmi, k = best_k_mediator) +
        factor(puberty_stage) + factor(sleep_category) + factor(fam_hx) +
        s(rel_family_id, k = best_k_mediator),
      data = df_sample
    )

    outcome_model <- gam(
      as.formula(paste(cognition_col, "~ s(SLF_I_left_Ten1_FA, k =", best_k_outcome, ") +",
                       "s(coi_total_raw, k =", best_k_outcome, ") +",
                       "s(interview_age, k =", best_k_outcome, ") +",
                       "s(parenteducation, k =", best_k_outcome, ") +",
                       "factor(sex) + factor(race) + factor(ethnicity) + factor(totalincome) +",
                       "factor(puberty_stage) + factor(sleep_category) + factor(fam_hx) +",
                       "factor(site_id_l) + s(rel_family_id, k =", best_k_outcome, ")")),
      data = df_sample
    )
    
    M_pred <- predict(mediator_model, newdata = df_sample)
    Y_pred <- predict(outcome_model, newdata = df_sample)
    

    coef(lm(Y_pred ~ M_pred, data = df_sample))[2]
  })
  

  mean_indirect_effect <- mean(bootstrap_results)
  ci_indirect_effect <- quantile(bootstrap_results, c(0.025, 0.975))
  
  all_results[[cognition_col]] <- list(
    mediator_model = best_mediator_model,
    outcome_model = best_outcome_model,
    total_effect_model = best_total_effect_model,
    best_k_mediator = best_k_mediator,
    best_k_outcome = best_k_outcome,
    best_k_total_effect = best_k_total_effect,
    indirect_effect = list(coefficient = indirect_effect_coefficient,
                           mean = mean_indirect_effect,
                           ci = ci_indirect_effect),
    mediation_proportion = mediation_proportion
  )
  all_bootstrap_results[[cognition_col]] <- list(mean = mean_indirect_effect, ci = ci_indirect_effect)
}

indirect_effects <- data.frame(
  Cognition_Outcome = cognition_outcomes,
  Indirect_Effect = sapply(all_bootstrap_results, function(x) x$mean),
  CI_Lower = sapply(all_bootstrap_results, function(x) x$ci[1]),
  CI_Upper = sapply(all_bootstrap_results, function(x) x$ci[2]),
  Mediation_Proportion = sapply(all_results, function(x) x$mediation_proportion)
)

print(indirect_effects)
```

  best_outcome_model <- outcome_results$best_model
  best_k_outcome <- outcome_results$best_k
  
  # Print summary for the outcome model
  cat("\n--- Summary for Outcome Model (Cognition ~ FA + COI) ---\n")
  print(summary(best_outcome_model))
  cat("Best k for Outcome Model:", best_k_outcome, "\n")
  
  # Step 3: Total Effect Model (Cognition ~ COI + Covariates)
  total_effect_results <- fit_and_evaluate_gam(
    data = df,
    response = cognition_col,
    predictors = total_effect_linear_predictors,
    smooth_terms = total_effect_smooth_terms,
    k_values = k_values
  )
  best_total_effect_model <- total_effect_results$best_model
  best_k_total_effect <- total_effect_results$best_k
  
  # Print summary for the total effect model
  cat("\n--- Summary for Total Effect Model (Cognition ~ COI + Covariates) ---\n")
  print(summary(best_total_effect_model))
  cat("Best k for Total Effect Model:", best_k_total_effect, "\n")
  
  # Step 4: Predict Mediator (FA) and Outcome (Cognition)
  df$M_pred <- predict(best_mediator_model, newdata = df)  # Predicted FA
  df$Y_pred <- predict(best_outcome_model, newdata = df)   # Predicted Cognition
  
  # Step 5: Compute Indirect Effect using Linear Regression
  indirect_effect <- lm(Y_pred ~ M_pred, data = df)
  indirect_effect_coefficient <- coef(indirect_effect)[2]
  
  # Step 6: Compute Mediation Proportion
  total_effect <- summary(best_total_effect_model)$s.table["s(coi_he_raw)", "F"]
  mediation_proportion <- indirect_effect_coefficient / total_effect
  
  # Step 7: Bootstrapping for Confidence Intervals
  set.seed(123)
  bootstrap_results <- replicate(1000, {
    sample_indices <- sample(nrow(df), replace = TRUE)
    df_sample <- df[sample_indices, ]
    
    mediator_model <- gam(
      SLF_I_left_Ten1_FA ~ s(coi_he_raw, k = best_k_mediator) + 
        s(interview_age, k = best_k_mediator) + s(dmri_meanmotion, k = best_k_mediator) +
        factor(sex) + factor(race) + factor(ethnicity) + factor(totalincome) +
        s(parenteducation, k = best_k_mediator) + s(bmi, k = best_k_mediator) +
        factor(puberty_stage) + factor(sleep_category) + factor(fam_hx) +
        s(rel_family_id, k = best_k_mediator),
      data = df_sample
    )

    outcome_model <- gam(
      as.formula(paste(cognition_col, "~ s(SLF_I_left_Ten1_FA, k =", best_k_outcome, ") +",
                       "s(coi_he_raw, k =", best_k_outcome, ") +",
                       "s(interview_age, k =", best_k_outcome, ") +",
                       "s(parenteducation, k =", best_k_outcome, ") +",
                       "factor(sex) + factor(race) + factor(ethnicity) + factor(totalincome) +",
                       "factor(puberty_stage) + factor(sleep_category) + factor(fam_hx) +",
                       "factor(site_id_l) + s(rel_family_id, k =", best_k_outcome, ")")),
      data = df_sample
    )
    

    M_pred <- predict(mediator_model, newdata = df_sample)
    Y_pred <- predict(outcome_model, newdata = df_sample)
    

    coef(lm(Y_pred ~ M_pred, data = df_sample))[2]
  })
  

  mean_indirect_effect <- mean(bootstrap_results)
  ci_indirect_effect <- quantile(bootstrap_results, c(0.025, 0.975))
  

  all_results[[cognition_col]] <- list(
    mediator_model = best_mediator_model,
    outcome_model = best_outcome_model,
    total_effect_model = best_total_effect_model,
    best_k_mediator = best_k_mediator,
    best_k_outcome = best_k_outcome,
    best_k_total_effect = best_k_total_effect,
    indirect_effect = list(coefficient = indirect_effect_coefficient,
                           mean = mean_indirect_effect,
                           ci = ci_indirect_effect),
    mediation_proportion = mediation_proportion
  )
  all_bootstrap_results[[cognition_col]] <- list(mean = mean_indirect_effect, ci = ci_indirect_effect)
}


indirect_effects <- data.frame(

#COI Overall -> SLF-I right -> Cognition --- Mediation model

fit_and_evaluate_gam <- function(data, response, predictors, smooth_terms, k_values) {
  results <- list()  
  
  for (k in k_values) {

    smooth_formula <- paste(
      sapply(smooth_terms, function(term) paste0("s(", term, ", k = ", k, ")")),
      collapse = " + "
    )
    
    full_formula <- paste(response, "~", smooth_formula, "+", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))
    
    # Fit the GAM model
    gam_model <- gam(as.formula(full_formula), data = data)
    

    results[[paste("k =", k)]] <- list(model = gam_model, AIC = AIC(gam_model))
  }
  

  best_k <- as.numeric(gsub("k = ", "", names(which.min(sapply(results, function(x) x$AIC)))))
  best_model <- results[[paste("k =", best_k)]]$model
  
  return(list(best_model = best_model, best_k = best_k, all_results = results))
}
